import sys
input = sys.stdin.read
data = input().split()

def bubble_sort_with_cost(arr):
    n = len(arr)
    total_cost = 0
    operations = []
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(0, n-i-1):
            if arr[j] > arr[j+1]:
                # Swap
                arr[j], arr[j+1] = arr[j+1], arr[j]
                # Calculate cost
                cost = abs(j - (j + 1))
                total_cost += cost
                operations.append((j + 1, j + 2))  # Convert to 1-based index
    return total_cost, operations

    index += 1

    index += N
